## Geometric construction

```{jsxgraph}
//| assessment_id: variant-point
//| width: 480
//| height: 360
var board=JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID,{boundingbox:[-3,3,3,-3],axis:true,keepaspectratio:true});
var p=board.create('point',[0.5,0.5],{name:'P',snapToGrid:false});
JXG.QuartoAssessment.register({board:board,response:function(){return {point:{x:p.X(),y:p.Y()}};}});
```
